projects.name: Advanced Discord Bot (ADB)
projects.description: Self-hosted, extensible Discord bot platform built around a capability-based plugin runtime. Untrusted third-party plugins load in isolated worker_threads and reach Discord, the database, network, and AI only through a custom JSON-RPC capability broker that enforces a deny-by-default, per-method permission catalog declared in each plugin's manifest — untrusted code never directly touches the Discord client, Mongoose, or environment secrets. Engineered a two-layer sandbox: V8-level resourceLimits (heap/young-gen/stack caps that kill a runaway thread) plus a software ResourceTracker enforcing per-call timeouts, CPU-per-minute throttling, max concurrency, and memory ceilings, with a strike-based auto-suspension policy (5 violations in a rolling 60s window) and crash auto-restart. Network egress is locked to a per-plugin host allowlist with manual-redirect and response-size caps; live per-plugin metrics, health scoring, and threshold alerts run on a 60s collector. Also built a Manifest v2 contract system (single source of truth driving process model, permissions, resource limits, and an install-time risk-disclosure flow), dependency-ordered plugin loading with semver engine checks, hot-reload via file watching, per-guild plugin enable gating on the hot event path, a Fastify admin dashboard with Discord OAuth, a versioned plugin marketplace/registry, and a supervisor watchdog that reverse-proxies plugin-hosted web UIs. ~18K LOC in the core plus ~19 first-party plugins (moderation, levels, giveaways, automod/aegis, music, reminders, and more).

stackUsed.infrastructure: MongoDB/Mongoose, Docker, npm plugin registry, supervisor watchdog + reverse proxy

projects.name: Gamify
projects.description: Open-source, self-hostable multi-tenant gamification platform (MERN) where organizations run point-bearing events, moderator-reviewed submissions, a redeemable reward shop, leaderboards, and levels. Enforces a five-tier RBAC model (Member/Moderator/Event Staff/Admin/Organisation) via role-derived permission flags, and awards points through a race-safe transaction service using atomic MongoDB $inc and balance-guarded conditional debits (points >= amount) with a full audit trail. Multi-auth via JWT+bcrypt, Google OAuth20 (Passport), and Discord identity linking; a companion Discord.js bot exchanges guild role IDs for scoped user JWTs through a shared bot-API-key and caches tokens/guild config. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages + Workers via GitHub Actions. Most-starred personal project (19+ stars).

projects.name: TransitOps
projects.description: Role-gated fleet/transport operations platform managing the full lifecycle of vehicles, drivers, trips, maintenance, and fuel/expense costs. Built on Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19 Server Components and Server Actions as the mutation layer, it enforces a strict business-rule state machine: dispatch/complete/cancel run inside Prisma transactions using raw SELECT ... FOR UPDATE pessimistic row locks to atomically flip trip/vehicle/driver statuses, re-validate cargo-vs-capacity and license expiry against the locked rows, auto-write fuel logs, and roll the odometer. RBAC is a role x domain access matrix enforced in three layers (Next.js route-proxy guard, per-action requireRole, and Zod schemas shared by client forms and server actions). Analytics KPIs (fuel efficiency, fleet utilization, operational cost) are derived live from aggregates rather than stored, and exported to CSV.
coreTech: Prisma transactions with SELECT FOR UPDATE pessimistic locking
Role x domain RBAC (proxy + server-action + Zod triple guard)
Next.js Server Actions as mutation layer

projects.name: AI Content Farm
projects.description: Go pipeline that auto-produces faceless short-form videos end-to-end: an LLM writes a multilingual (English/Hindi/Telugu) script, TTS synthesizes voiceover, and FFmpeg renders it over looping background footage into a portrait/landscape/square MP4. Engineered as a single CGO-free binary with a goroutine worker pool (buffered channel + WaitGroup, context-cancelled graceful shutdown, on-boot requeue of persisted jobs) fronted by a Go net/http API and an embedded vanilla-JS mobile UI (go:embed). Layers a fallback LLM chain (Gemini to OpenRouter to local heuristic) with resilient JSON extraction; a TTS provider router (local Piper ONNX Flask sidecar vs ElevenLabs) with language-aware routing, credit-exhaustion auto-failover, and retries; FFmpeg/ffprobe rendering with atempo-chained duration capping; yt-dlp background-clip ingestion; pure-Go SQLite persistence; and Docker-socket lifecycle control of the TTS container.

projects.name: Vijaya Store (E-commerce Monorepo)
projects.description: Flutter + Next.js e-commerce monorepo built for a real print/stationery/bookstore business selling academic books and printable PDFs. Ships two Flutter apps (a customer storefront and an admin console) plus a Next.js 14 App-Router API, sharing a flutter_shared Dart package (models, API client, token manager). Customers browse a hierarchical category/subject catalog, view PDF previews, manage a cart, and check out to COD/Razorpay orders with delivery-address snapshots; admins manage products/variants, categories, orders, users, feedback and support off a dashboard. Backend uses Prisma over PostgreSQL with modular repo/service/validator layers, Zod validation, Upstash Redis rate-limiting, hybrid auth (Firebase ID-token verification exchanged for app-issued JWT access/refresh pairs), FCM push notifications to admins on new orders, and server-side image/PDF handling (sharp, pdf-lib) that auto-generates PNG previews. Products carry COLOR/BW/DEFAULT print variants with per-variant SKUs and pricing.
coreTech: Flutter monorepo (customer + admin apps + shared Dart package)

projects.name: Jarvis Voice Assistant
projects.description: Cross-platform voice assistant split across a Kotlin Android client and a Python FastAPI 'brain'. The app runs an event-driven agentic pipeline (Input-Intent-Plan-Execute-Respond) with state-gated wake-word listening, Android SpeechRecognizer STT, WebRTC VAD via C/C++ JNI, and hybrid rule+classifier intent routing. Local skills (app launch, system control, timers) run under a timeout/retry engine; LLM inference is local-first via MediaPipe LiteRT on-device (Gemma/Qwen) with Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic cloud fallback and per-provider cooldowns, plus RAG over markdown memory with embeddings in SQLite. An optional Python brain (FastAPI, X-API-Key auth) rule-classifies requests, runs DuckDuckGo search with sentence-transformer semantic ranking, and serves llama.cpp Llama-3.2-1B through a queued single-worker inference loop.
coreTech: Semantic-ranked web search with confidence gating

projects.name: ArogyaKrishi
projects.description: Farmer-facing crop-disease detection and advisory app pairing a Flutter frontend with an async FastAPI backend. A user photographs a leaf; the app compresses and multipart-uploads it, and the backend returns disease + crop + confidence backed by a multilingual (English/Telugu/Hindi/Kannada/Malayalam) remedy knowledge base. Layers geolocated nearby-disease alerts (Haversine radius queries over a PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy-async store with 6h duplicate suppression), OpenStreetMap Overpass lookups for nearby pesticide shops (three-mirror failover), a product-label treatment verifier, and an OpenAI text/voice agri-chatbot (gpt-4o-mini chat + STT/TTS) with multilingual fallbacks, plus a fully offline on-device symptom-to-disease scoring mode. Image-classification pipeline built on a HuggingFace MobileNetV2 plant-disease model with an Ollama advisory layer.

projects.name: Tailscale Plasma Widget
projects.description: KDE Plasma 6 panel/desktop widget that controls Tailscale from the system tray. A C++/Qt6 backend (registered to QML via QML_ELEMENT) polls `tailscale status --json` every 5s, parses BackendState, Self IP, and the Peer map into a diffing QAbstractListModel (keyed by IP so inline ping results survive refresh), and drives connect/disconnect, profile switching, and exit-node routing. Commands run via QProcess with argv arrays (never shell strings) plus allowlist validation of profile/host args to prevent flag/command injection. Privilege is handled without sudo: it detects 'Access denied' and surfaces a one-time `tailscale set --operator=$USER` banner. The QML full view (Kirigami/Plasma components) offers list/grid device layouts, sort/filter, ping, and clipboard copy.
coreTech: Argument allowlisting to prevent command injection

projects.name: Calico Kubernetes Observability Lab
projects.description: Local Kubernetes observability lab that instruments Calico's networking data plane with a Prometheus/Grafana monitoring stack. Provisions a two-node kind cluster with the default CNI disabled and a 192.168.0.0/16 pod subnet, installs Calico v3.27.0 as the active CNI, and exposes Felix metrics on port 9091. Deploys the kube-prometheus-stack via Helm, then wires a custom ServiceMonitor (k8s-app=calico-node selector, 30s scrape interval, calico-system namespaceSelector) so Prometheus auto-discovers and scrapes the calico-node target. Grafana visualizes live Felix metrics (CPU, GC, process memory/RSS, open file descriptors, datastore resyncs), closing the loop from CNI data plane to dashboards. Companion to Certified Calico Operator (Level 1 + eBPF) certifications.

stackUsed.infrastructure: Kubernetes (kind, 2-node), Calico v3.27.0 CNI, Prometheus, Grafana, Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor CRD, Helm, Docker

projects.name: Petrol Pump Management System
projects.description: Digitized fuel-delivery platform for Indian petrol pumps combining a Next.js 14 App-Router backend/admin dashboard with a Flutter (Riverpod) mobile app for customers and employees, over a Supabase Postgres database modeled in Prisma. Implements three-role RBAC (Customer/Employee/Admin) via Supabase-Auth JWT verification, an order lifecycle (pending to delivered to completed) supporting amount- or quantity-based orders, per-customer indent-number allocation enforced atomically inside Prisma transactions, daily fuel-price management with historical lookup and fallback, a running customer-balance/payment billing model, and audit logging of admin actions. Inputs are Zod-validated; the admin dashboard (25 API routes, tabbed orders/prices/billing/users/employee-activity) uses Recharts and Supabase real-time subscriptions for live order updates. Real-world software built to run the family petrol pump.
coreTech: Prisma transactions with atomic indent allocation
